rules.statement: Jackie supported V after Arasaka revoked V's corporate status at Lizzie's. They already knew each other; this was not their first meeting.
Jackie supported V after Arasaka revoked V's corporate status at Lizzie's. They already knew each other; this was not their first meeting.
V and Jackie survived their rival attempt to steal the car and began their partnership after the police released them.
V and Jackie escaped the failed border smuggling run together and agreed to help each other in Night City.
V paid Royce for the Flathead with personal funds during the deal Jackie attended.
V handed Royce the compromised Militech chip without warning him about its malware.
V offered Royce a Militech-chip payment after warning him about the malware or saying it had been removed.
V interrupted the negotiations with a direct attack on Royce: a shooting or physical takedown.
V shot and killed Royce during the Flathead negotiations. Jackie was present.
V incapacitated Royce with the physical takedown during the negotiations. This receipt does not establish his eventual survival or later Maelstrom leadership.
V and Jackie finished the Flathead transaction and left All Foods through the peaceful factory route.
V and Jackie survived the Militech assault inside All Foods and completed the factory escape.
V and Jackie escaped the hostile Maelstrom factory after the negotiation broke down.
V and Jackie obtained the Flathead for Dex's heist job.
Meredith Stout met V and Jackie outside All Foods after the factory job.
Anthony Gilchrist met V and Jackie after the factory job.
During the briefing, V told Dex about Evelyn's proposal to cut him out. Jackie and T-Bug heard the disclosure.
Dex promised a thirty-five percent cut for the heist during the briefing Jackie attended. This was a promise, not payment received.
Dex promised a forty percent heist cut as a bonus for V's honesty about Evelyn. Jackie attended the briefing. This was not payment received.
V and Jackie witnessed Yorinobu kill Saburo while hiding in the Konpeki penthouse.
V and Jackie witnessed Yorinobu kill Saburo while hiding in the Konpeki penthouse.
T-Bug's connection failed during the Konpeki lockdown while V and Jackie were escaping.
Takemura recovered V from the landfill after killing Dex. V and Takemura survived the pursuing Arasaka attackers together and sought medical help.
V and Takemura began cooperating after their diner conversation about Saburo's murder and the Relic predicament.
Oda refused to help V and Takemura after the secret meeting and warned them about pursuing Hanako.
V accepted the shared van ride with Takemura to Jig-Jig Street.
V joined Takemura for reconnaissance of the Arasaka industrial park.
V declined joining the industrial-park reconnaissance, leaving Takemura to scout alone.
Takemura told V that Arasaka took Jackie's body and could extract a damaged, incomplete engram with Soulkiller. Takemura admitted he understood little of the method.
V compromised the parade float's system at the Arasaka industrial park and withdrew, completing that part of Takemura's plan.
V cleared the parade sniper route and reached the netrunner's access point while supporting Takemura.
V killed Oda at the parade despite Takemura's appeal for mercy.
Takemura forcibly abducted Hanako from the parade, and V escaped the ensuing pursuit.
In the safe house, Hanako heard V say they witnessed Saburo's death and accuse Yorinobu of the murder. Takemura was present.
V returned upstairs for Takemura during the safe-house assault, and they both escaped.
V escaped the safe-house assault without bringing Takemura out. The resulting story branch treats Takemura as lost; Johnny had urged V to leave.
V and Jackie recovered Sandra Dorsett and transferred her alive to Trauma Team, with T-Bug supporting the extraction.
V and Jackie recovered Sandra Dorsett and transferred her alive to Trauma Team, with T-Bug supporting the extraction.
Delamain confirmed that Jackie’s body was delivered to his family, and Mama Welles later held his ofrenda.
Mama Welles knew Jackie had died and mourned him.
